# Dust (ambient particle layers)

**Object:** `Custom_1114_Dust.xml` dialog `1114` (persistent, `zorder 0`, generated by `gen_dust46.py`, **do not hand edit**) · `Includes_Dust3.xml` (`BezelLitDust`, `BezelLitDustP` album/poster lit dust) · menu dust under the MM (`BzMMDustA`, Includes_Tuner)  
**Where:** Black void around the colour block / art / mini-player, on every BEZEL screen after the splash  
**Last updated:** 2026-10-31 · 5.33.207  
**Status:** draft. This doc matches the live tuner rows. Rob has not approved it.  
**Skin:** skin.bezel2

Each section has three layers: **Simple** (what it does and why), **How it works** (the flow end to end, with the order and the races), and **Wiring** (props, conditions, controls, scripts and timings, all read from the live tree).

---

## What it is

**Simple.** Slow drifting dust in the black space of the screen. It starts once after the splash and keeps drifting across window changes, so it never restarts or jumps.

**How it works.** 1114 is a dialog with a `<visible>` condition. Kodi opens and closes it by that condition, and no script calls `ActivateWindow`. It sits at `zorder 0`, below every other dialog. The condition waits for the warm gate (`bz_splash_done=1`), so dust never draws under the splash. It turns off in fullscreen video, slideshow, screensaver, PVR windows, editors/settings, filebrowser and the rest of the listed windows. Because the dialog stays open between windows, the particle animations keep their phase. Each layer is clipped by grouplists to the void rectangles of the current screen mode, and a black feather overlay softens the edges.

**Wiring.**
- Visible starts: `String.IsEqual(Window(Home).Property(bz_splash_done),1) + !Skin.HasSetting(bz_dust_off) + !Window.IsActive(fullscreenvideo) + !Window.IsActive(slideshow) + !Window.IsActive(screensaver) + !Window.IsActive(1113) + …` (PVR, editors, skinsettings, filebrowser, screencalibration and others).
- Mode groups: one set of void-rect grouplists for Music list mode (`Window.IsActive(music) + !$EXP[bz_gridset] + !$EXP[bz_np] + empty bz_back …`) and the negation set for everything else. Plus `Skin.HasSetting(bz_amb_below) + !bz_dust_nocut` for BELOW ambient (4.7.2).
- Ambient BELOW: `Includes_Bezel` ~582 copies the Far/Mid/Spin layers under the section group (Tuner DUST › Ambient position). 1114 hides its own ambient in Music/Videos while that copy shows.
- Exit: `bz_cmd.py quit/exit` → `Dialog.Close(1114,true)` before quitting (BEZEL 3.0 exit fix).
- Regenerate: `bz_tune_patch.py` patches `Custom_1114_Dust.xml` and `Includes_Dust3.xml` through a temp file (it never writes in place, 3.0 fix).

## Layers

**Simple.** Distant, Mid and Ambient spin dust in the void. Menu dust shows while the Main Menu is open. Lit dust sits over album and poster art.

**Wiring.** Lit dust: `BezelLitDust` visible `!bz_adust_off + !bz_dust_off`. `BezelLitDustP` visible `!bz_dust_off`. Menu dust colour `$VAR[BzMMDustA]` from `bz_at_mmdbright`.

## Keys / touch

**Simple.** None. Dust is decorative and never takes focus.

## Tuner rows (BEZEL Tuner › DUST, `bz_tune.json`)
| Row id | Layer | Options | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| d20fdens / d20mdens / d20sdens | Distant / Mid / Spin density | Low · Med · High | Med / Low / Med |
| d20fsize / d20msize / d20ssize / mmdsize | Distant / Mid / Spin / Menu **particle size** | **90% · 100% · 125%** | 90 / 90 / 100 / 90 % |
| d20fbri / d20mbri / d20sbri, mmdbright | Opacity | 10%–100% in 10 steps (no 0%) | see skin-settings-tuner.md |
| d20ffade / d20mfade / d20sfade / mmdfade | Twinkle fade | Off · Slow · Mid · Fast · Faster | Mid / Slow / Slow / Mid |
| d20fslide / d20mslide / mmdslide | Drift slide | Off · Slow · Mid · Fast · Faster | Fast / Slow / Mid |
| d3dens, d3lsize, d3asize, d3amb, d3lit, d3glow, d3goff, spinspd, lspinspd, d3speed | Album Dust3 (lit, ambient, glow, spin) | various | per json |
| pd3lit, pd3lsize, plspinspd, pfibamt, pflkamt, pdust | Poster Dust3 | various | per json |
| sdsize, sdbright, fibamt, flkamt, breathe, glow0–4 | Extra sparkle/fibre/flake/breathe | various | per json |

Presets (`bz_tune.py dust`: subtle / mid / …) set density, size, brightness, fade and slide together. Bars and labels come from `BzATVal_*` / `BzATBar_*` in Includes_Tuner.
